Self-Host Penpot: The Open-Source Figma Alternative That Speaks Code

Quick thread 🧵
> Penpot is an open-source, browser-based design and prototyping tool, a genuine Figma alternative built on open web standards (SVG and CSS) for both designers and developers.
Self-hosting it makes sense when you are a team or an agency feeling per-editor pricing, or when design files need to stay on infrastructure you control.
It is worth being honest that Penpot is not one of the featherweight self-hosted tools: it runs several services with PostgreSQL and Redis behind them, so give it real memory.
On Kloudbean it is a one-click app, so you skip the Docker Compose file and run it on a managed server with a managed database.
